_comment: Identity controls used in hardened mode and by evaluate_kpi.py --scan. 'on_behalf_of': the agent exchanges the caller's token for a short-lived on-behalf-of (OBO) token and fetches documents with it, so the document service authorises the caller, not the agent's service identity. 'session_binding': every token the agent accepts must be unexpired and bound to the session the request arrived on, so a delegated token from an earlier session cannot be replayed. Both are needed: each closes a different path. TTLs are in seconds.
